overview: The Senate Hall is the center of Loyalist governance, where senators debate policy, issue decrees, and maintain political stability across Katta Castellum.
history: Constructed after the Loyalist schism to establish a formal republic.
The Senate Chamber was designed with acoustics optimized for debate.
Arcane wards were installed to prevent magical interference during sessions.
The Hall has hosted centuries of political rulings and civic reforms.
hooks: A controversial decree sparks unrest in the lower wards.
A senator disappears under suspicious circumstances.
Arcane wards destabilize during a heated debate.
A foreign envoy arrives seeking political alliance.
